text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's already budding? Can I come by
later and
take photos? I want to add
them to Umastagram!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's fine with me. You're always taking
photos
and videos, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I want to make lots of records and

memories of my time here!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see you leaving likes on them too
sometimes.
Thank you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You should be thanking those impressive

photography skills of yours.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
By the way... Don't you want to buy a
proper
camera?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No, I have enough features on my phone
camera,
and I want my photos to feel
candid.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I've taken lots of good ones
recently! ♪
They're not on Umastagram
yet!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Which one would you like to see? I've
got a rare
six-leaf clover, Dober
sleeping, my recent
favorite ramen, a
video of Shakur typing...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Or how about the cute one I've got of
you with a
ladybug on your shoulder? ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, when did you take that last one?
